fact_text: On 27 Apr 2026 the State Bank of Pakistan raised its policy rate by 100 basis points to 11.5%, its first increase since June 2024.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The State Bank had held the policy rate at 10.5% at its March 2026 monetary policy meeting, which the interviewee called a surprising decision.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Before the April 2026 decision, market views were split between no change and a 50 basis point hike, and few had expected a 100 basis point move, so the hike was above expectations.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The six-month money market deal yield was about 11.22% before the announcement, below the new 11.5% policy rate, and the interviewee said yields were already pricing in the hike.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Consumer price inflation for February and March 2026 was about 7%, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The interviewee expected April 2026 inflation near 10-11%, with May and June also in double digits, driven by higher transport and energy prices.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The interviewee expected inflation of about 8-9% in Q4 FY26, above the State Bank's earlier projection of 5-7%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Pakistan's primary surplus in the first half of FY26 was about 3.2% of GDP, against a State Bank target of about 3% and an IMF target of 2.8%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: With FBR revenues showing a shortfall and GDP slowing, the government would need to curb spending or add revenue measures to hold the deficit and primary surplus.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The State Bank's foreign exchange reserves target is about $18 billion by June 2026, and the interviewee said the target was not expected to be revised down.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Foreign reserves were about $15 billion, with $1.5 billion of external repayments still ahead.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The State Bank expected FY26 remittances of about $41 billion, down from an initial expectation of $42 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The interviewee expected the rupee to stay broadly stable against the US dollar, with no pressure on the exchange rate from the rate decision.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Portfolio investment has seen outflows, which the interviewee attributed mainly to uncertainty about the outlook.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: After a rate hike, bank deposit costs rise almost immediately while asset yields reprice over three to six months, so net margins can be squeezed in the short term.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Banks holding more fixed-rate PIBs take a larger short-term hit from a rate rise, while the interviewee saw higher rates as positive for banks over the long term.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Some suggested raising the cash reserve requirement alongside the rate hike, but the State Bank did not do so; the interviewee saw the policy rate as the more meaningful lever for large-scale manufacturing credit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The interviewee expected an initial negative stock market reaction, especially in highly leveraged and cyclical sectors, while bank stocks were expected to react positively.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: With April 2026 inflation near 10%, the 11.5% policy rate left a real rate gap of about 1.5 percentage points, down from a gap of 700-800 basis points before the US-Iran war inflation shock.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Food carries a 34% weight in the CPI basket, and food inflation has been fairly contained for about three to four months to April 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The interviewee said global urea and fertilizer prices had spiked to unprecedented levels, a risk of second-round food inflation if supply tightens further.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Higher furnace oil and energy prices were expected to push up electricity tariffs, adding to transport-driven inflation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Capacity utilisation in autos, cement and other industries is below 50%, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: High-frequency indicators such as auto sales, cement dispatches and trade look positive, but the interviewee said they mostly reflect a low base effect after GDP growth was negligible for three to four years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The State Bank's initial FY26 GDP growth target was 3.5-4.5%, and the interviewee expected growth near the lower end; the SBP said Q3 FY26 growth would beat Q2, with Q4 possibly slower.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The interviewee said growth needs fiscal stimulus or structural reforms, because earlier rate cuts had already provided some monetary stimulus.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The interviewee called the hike prudent because Pakistan's economy is fragile with limited buffers, so shocks are magnified, and the State Bank put stability ahead of growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: The State Bank framed its decision on a six-to-nine-month inflation view, with about three quarters of the fiscal year left, so it has room to respond further.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)

fact_text: Oil prices were above pre-war levels, and the interviewee said they could stay high even if the US-Iran war ends, because of damage to infrastructure.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'State Bank announces increase in interest rates to 11.5% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-27)
